title: Junta Airstrike Damages KIA-Controlled Sinkhan Bridge Over the Ayeyarwady, Bhamo Township
detail: The junta carried out an airstrike on the afternoon of September 6, 2026 against Sinkhan Bridge, a KIA-controlled Ayeyarwady River crossing in Bhamo Township, Kachin State, damaging the bridge deck, steel framework and side stairways. The strike is part of the regime's push to reopen the Shwegu-Sinkhan road and river route to resupply its isolated garrisons in Bhamo, after its Ayeyarwady flotilla lost eight vessels and over 100 personnel to a KIA-PDF ambush along the same stretch on September 2.

title: Resistance Forces Mine Junta Convoy Near Natmauk, Magway Region
detail: Local resistance forces laid two minefields targeting a junta convoy of two vehicles carrying about 20 troops in Natmauk Township, Magway Region on the morning of September 6, 2026. The first vehicle avoided detonation after its jammer disrupted the device, but the second vehicle was successfully struck; casualties among the junta troops were not independently confirmed. The attack follows a September 3 ambush by the Natmauk People's Defence Organization that killed 3 soldiers and wounded 15 in the same area.
